## MCP Canary MCP Server

MCP Canary is synthetic monitoring for remote MCP servers. Its remote MCP server lets an AI assistant inspect any public MCP endpoint without calling its tools: it reports the transport (Streamable HTTP or legacy SSE), the negotiated protocol version, server info, the tool list with input and output schemas, and a side-effect class for each tool derived from its MCP hints. Target problems come back as stable failure codes (for example TARGET_UNAVAILABLE, TARGET_AUTH_FAILED, MCP_PROTOCOL_ERROR). A second tool returns the plans and prices of the monitoring service. Both tools are read-only and need no authentication; private and loopback addresses are rejected.
